shortDescription: Bank of America NYSE:BAC said on Thursday it plans to hire 1,000 additional apprentices over the next two years, expanding its skills-based hiring in local communities.

children: said on Thursday it plans to hire 1,000 additional apprentices over the next two years, expanding its skills-based hiring in local communities.
The commitment is on top of the more than 800 apprentices the company already hires each year through programs across its consumer banking, technology and other business areas.
The additional hires will target workers without a four-year college degree.

As part of the initiative, Bank of America will invest $150 million over five years in workforce development organizations that help individuals gain job-ready skills and connect with employment opportunities, the company said.
The bank also said the funding would support local organizations, universities, community colleges and nonprofit groups focused on workforce training.
